method: Prices are 2026 (or current) model-year MSRP as reported by manufacturer pages, manufacturer press releases, or aggregator/trade-press pages (motorcycle.com spec pages, dealer 'Model List' pages built from manufacturer feeds, ridermagazine.com, powersportsbusiness.com, cyclenews.com, newatlas.com) found via web search on 2026-10-05, because most manufacturer sites (powersports.honda.com, ducati.com, triumphmotorcycles.com) blocked direct fetches with HTTP 403. Where a manufacturer page was fetched directly and cited, sourceType is 'primary'; all other figures, read via search-result text rather than a direct page fetch, are marked 'secondary' and the most specific URL surfaced by the search is recorded. No currency conversion was performed; all US-market prices are USD and all Canada-market prices are CAD, exactly as quoted on the source. No tank, displacement, economy, battery or weight figure is recorded unless it was explicitly stated in the source text; most such fields are null because only price data was reliably confirmed for most models in the time available. Several makes researched (Energica, Arch Motorcycle, Segway, Sur-Ron, SYM, Brixton, CSC Motorcycles, Fantic, Lambretta Canada-specific, Sherco, Bimota) could not be priced with confidence and were omitted; see the final summary for details.
